candidates: The assertion `assert stats["total_items"] > 0` at line 200 is race-prone: worker threads may process all 10 items before `get_stats()` is called, causing the assertion to fail

The `create_thread_queue_parallel_worker` method reuses the same `self.queue_pool` instance across multiple calls to `create_with_partitions`. When Arroyo rebalances partitions, the previous strategy's `close()` already called `self.queue_pool.shutdown()`, so subsequent calls pass the shutdown pool to new `SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy` instances, causing `put()` operations to raise exceptions and break message processing
